name: linear_update_issue
description: Update an existing Linear issue. Requires the issue `id` (UUID, from linear_list_issues / linear_get_issue). Provide any of `title`, `description`, `stateId` (move status — get ids from linear_list_workflow_states), `priority` (0-4), `assigneeId`. Only the fields you pass are changed. Returns { success, issue { id identifier title state { name } } }.

priority.description: New priority: 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low.

assigneeId.description: User id to assign the issue to.

body_defaults.query: mutation UpdateIssue($id: String!, $input: IssueUpdateInput!) { issueUpdate(id: $id, input: $input) { success issue { id identifier title state { name } } } }
